questions.text: Is there something in your life that has more control over you than you'd like?
questions.verse_text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

questions.text: What does freedom from this struggle look like in your imagination?
questions.verse_text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

questions.text: What triggers make the temptation hardest to resist?
questions.verse_text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

questions.text: Have you found any strategies that help you resist, even temporarily?
questions.verse_text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

questions.text: Do you believe God still loves you in the middle of this struggle?
questions.verse_text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

questions.text: What void or pain might this habit be trying to fill?
questions.verse_text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

questions.text: Is there someone you trust enough to be accountable to?
questions.verse_text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

questions.text: What would you do with your life if this chain was broken?
questions.verse_text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound.

questions.text: Can you remember a time when you felt truly free? What was that like?
questions.verse_text: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance.

questions.text: Would you like to pray together for God's power to break this hold?
questions.verse_text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
